description: Source code for engine sniffer and wave chart logic in the rusEfi project, including functions for logging, resetting, and publishing wave data, as well as managing chart size and status.

classes.name: WaveChart
classes.description: Class managing wave chart data collection, logging, and publishing for engine sniffer.

methods.name: WaveChart::reset
methods.description: Resets the wave chart logging and counters.

methods.name: WaveChart::isStartedTooLongAgo
methods.description: Checks if the wave chart has been active for too long without new data.

methods.name: WaveChart::isFull
methods.description: Checks if the wave chart has reached its maximum size.

methods.name: WaveChart::publish
methods.description: Publishes the current wave chart data if conditions are met.

methods.name: WaveChart::addEvent3
methods.description: Logs an event with a name and message into the wave chart.

methods.name: WaveChart::init
methods.description: Initializes the wave chart logging system.

methods.name: WaveChart::publishIfFull
methods.description: Publishes and resets the wave chart if it is full or too old.
